UNUSUAL.Definition: not common or ordinary; strange or surprising

STIFFER.Definition: stronger and harder to deal with

GRUESOME.Definition: horrible and shocking because of violence and death

DEVOLVED.Definition: given some powers by the central government to govern itself

AUTONOMY.Definition: the freedom to govern itself and make its own decisions

PRECURSOR.Definition: a thing that existed earlier and developed into something later

HERITAGE.Definition: the history, traditions and culture passed down from earlier generations

REFERENDUM.Definition: a vote in which all the people decide on one important question

GRASSROOTS.Definition: ordinary people and members of a movement, not its leaders

MAINSTREAM.Definition: belonging to the large, widely accepted parties; not extreme

DEPRIVED.Definition: poor, without enough money or good living conditions

OPTIMISM.Definition: a feeling of hope and confidence about the future

PROPONENTS.Definition: people who support an idea or plan

PAPER RUNS.Definition: regular trips delivering newspapers to people's homes

STARK.Definition: very clear and obvious; impossible to ignore

IRREVERSIBLE.Definition: impossible to change back or undo

SEAMLESSLY.Definition: smoothly, with no gaps or problems

INTEGRATED.Definition: joined closely with something so that both work as one

SIBLING.Definition: a brother or sister; here, a closely connected country

COMPONENT.Definition: a part that makes up a larger whole

CURRENCY.Definition: the system of money used in a country

NODDING YOUR HEAD.Definition: moving your head up and down to show you agree

BACKFIRED.Definition: had the opposite effect to what was intended

PUSHED BACK.Definition: resisted; refused to accept a demand

AFTERMATH.Definition: the period after an important event, and its effects

POLLS.Definition: surveys in which people are asked their opinions, especially about voting

PREVAILING.Definition: most common or widespread at a particular time

COMMENTATORS.Definition: people who discuss and give opinions on news and politics in the media

CONCESSIONS.Definition: things given to someone to satisfy them and reduce disagreement

AFFAIRS.Definition: matters and business, especially public or political ones

PLACATE.Definition: make less angry or unhappy; calm and satisfy

BLOODIEST.Definition: most violent, with the most people killed or injured
